newsitem.title: USA: Marcus says Q2 net hit by interest expense.
newsitem.headline: Marcus says Q2 net hit by interest expense.

text.p: Marcus Corp said Thursday that higher interest expense related to its long-term debt held net income to a 2.9-percent gain in the second quarter.
Operating income rose to $13.4 million from $11.8 million a year earlier, an increase of 13.5 percent, it said.
The rise in the net figure was hurt by higher interest expense from the placement of $85 million in debt, said Marcus.
Marcus owns movie theaters, motels, hotel/resorts and restaurants in three Midwest states and Colorado.
The company's stock was up 1/8 at 21-3/4.
